# Council Automation

**Version 1.0** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3810883437) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=council-automation&expanded=true)

Stop babysitting your council. When your **Court Chaplain**, **Steward** or **Marshal** finishes converting, promoting culture in, or increasing control over a county, they move straight on to the next one. No more coming back five years later to find them idle.

## What it does

- **Court Chaplain — Convert Faith**
- **Steward — Promote Culture**
- **Marshal — Increase Control**

When one of these tasks finishes, or you cancel it, the councillor picks the next valid county and starts the same task there. In order of preference:

1. your capital
1. your own counties
1. your direct vassals' capitals, largest realms first
1. your sub-vassals' capitals
1. anywhere else in your realm

Within each step it prefers the county most likely to go smoothly: the highest opinion for conversion and culture, the highest control for Increase Control.

Only **player** councils are automated. The AI plays as it always has.

## Built on the game's own rules

Council tasks can only be modded by replacing them whole, which is why mods like this tend to break, or quietly undo the base game's changes, every time CK3 updates.

Council Automation's task definitions are **generated from the game itself**, and the only thing added is the automation. Which counties can be targeted is decided by the game's own rules, too. So the By God Alone changes to conversion (rites, theocracies, the Theological Agent) all work as Paradox intended, and future patches are a quick rebuild, not a rewrite.

## Compatibility

- Built for **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** (By God Alone).
- **Replaces Automatic Council Tasks.** Do not run both.
- Conflicts with any other mod that redefines *task_conversion*, *task_promote_culture* or *task_increase_control*. Whichever loads last wins.
- Safe to add or remove mid-game.
- Changes no achievement-relevant rules, but, as with any mod, check the launcher for achievement compatibility.

## Credit

The idea and the county-selection order come from [Automatic Council Tasks](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3604126943) by Hamzah Hayat, used under its MIT licence. Council Automation rebuilds it on CK3 1.20's own council tasks.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `council-automation-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=council-automation&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
